raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the independent variable by claiming the amount of water was varied and fertilizer type was constant. According to the procedure, water was held constant (5 minutes/day) and the factor intentionally varied was the type/brand of fertilizer; thus the correct independent variable is the type of fertilizer.
